name: Improved Erratic Mutation
body:
Through unforeseen means, you’ve learned how to perform new and amazing mutations.

Prerequisite(s): Ouphe, Con 13, character level 5

Benefit(s): Choose one of the following mutation traits. You gain it in addition to your mutations. You may choose to enhance this mutation too.

Molecular Mending

The Ouphe gains the ability to recover from serious injuries by reshaping its body.

Benefit(s): This mutation grants Godless Healing as a bonus feat. Double all healing done by this ability.

Enhanced: As long as this mutation is enhanced, whenever you use Godless Healing, you may cast restoration on yourself as a spelllike ability and you may use Godless Healing regardless of your remaining hitpoints.

Mystery Might

The Ouphe is granted a stronger frame and improved muscular power.

Benefit(s): This mutation allows the Ouphe to count as one size larger for the purpose of determining CMB and the Ouphe’s ability to perform combat maneuvers (for example, an Ouphe with this mutation may perform grapple combat maneuvers against large foes). Enhanced: As long as this mutation is enhanced, the Ouphe counts as one size larger for the purpose of determining CMD and how combat maneuvers affect it.

Mystic Metronome

The Ouphe develops an organ to quickly reproduce spells.

Benefit(s): This mutation grants the Ouphe the Echoing Spell metamagic feat. Enhanced: As long as this mutation is enhanced, recasting spells becomes second nature to the Ouphe, allowing her to cast a spell and the copy granted by Echoing Spell simultaneously as a full-round action.
